Dimensions and limits

A 24 mm ball on a 10 mm stem carries the charger cup. A rear socket and two removable front cheeks clamp around it with two provisional M4 × 35 bolts and nuts. Loosen, aim, then tighten. Gold shows the two front cheeks, which fit around the stem and locate on small pegs. The previous cup becomes the fixed round support; the fitted charger pocket moves onto the teal head.

Preview range: ±25° sideways and ±10° tilt; these are design limits, not physical stops. The phone moves 44 mm forward at neutral. The original taped base, side flanges and lower cable guides remain. Wall angle and tape contact are provisional.

CAD checks cover 55 angle combinations against the fixed mount and approximate dashboard. Real brow clearance is still unknown. These discrete poses do not prove clearance at every intermediate angle. Phone: 163 × 82.1 × 10 mm; camera projection and charging-ring location remain assumptions.

The dashed line is a proposed flexible cable loop, not a verified route. It must flex between the moving cup and fixed post clips. The lower cable route remains checked. Actual bend radius and snagging need a physical check.

Assuming 0.35 kg and 5 Earth g sideways, moving forward 44 mm adds 0.76 N·m at the base. Ball holding torque, hot ASA creep, wear, tape retention and print orientation remain unverified. The previous engineering report does not qualify this swivel.

Download concept parts: base · left cheek · right cheek · cup and ball. No print-ready files.
